versions.content: ImplementationDataType can express concepts not avail- able on application level As a consequence of the specific focus, it is possible to express concepts with an ImplementationDataType that are not supported on the application level, i.e. by ApplicationDataType : • ImplementationDataType supports the definition of pointers • It is possible to define alias names just as in a typedef • It is possible to define nested ImplementationDataType s but in contrast to the concept implemented for ApplicationDataType these implement a direct aggregation of sub-elements rather than applying the type-prototype pattern.
